title: SearchResponse
description: Response envelope for the verana-graph faceted-search endpoint `POST /v4/graph/search` per [TG-FCT-6]. Each `hits[].snippet` MUST carry the per-surface minimum of [TG-FCT-6a]: the entity's primary key, `lastObservedAtTime`, the visibility flags applicable to the surface (`isTrustExpired` for `Did`, `archived` for `Ecosystem` / `CredentialSchema`), the DID binding on DID-bound surfaces (`did` on `Did` / `Corporation` / `Ecosystem`, `didId` on `ServiceEndpoint`), and, on the `Did` surface, the result-card fields (service name, type, description, both logos, operator identity, the owner Corporation's trust signals — deposit and slash history — and the declared service endpoints). Implementations MAY surface additional per-card fields (additionalProperties open). Per [TG-FCT-7] the `cursor` field is opaque and is the only way to fetch subsequent pages. All datetime values are ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC strings (see `#/$defs/Iso8601DateTime`). See `### Search REST binding` in the verana-graph spec.

query.description: Echo of the request payload (per [TG-FCT-6]). Validates against `request.schema.json`; not re-validated structurally here to avoid coupling response validation to request constraints.

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the filtered, gated query — not the size of `hits[]` (which is bounded by the request's `limit`).

hits.description: Page of ranked hits, ordered by descending `score`.

facets.description: Aggregations keyed by filter field name. Per [TG-FCT-6] the `facets` object MUST contain aggregations for at least every `eq` / `in` filter field declared on the queried surface in [TG-FCT-3].

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page, or `null` when this is the last page. Per [TG-FCT-7] cursors MAY become invalid; subsequent calls with an invalid cursor MUST return an explicit error rather than silently re-anchoring.

Iso8601DateTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC.

Bech32Address.description: Cosmos bech32 address with the `verana` HRP. Used for `Corporation.policyAddress` and for the per-Participant `vsOperator` account; NOT used as a primary key.

Hit.description: A single ranked hit. The `snippet` shape is discriminated by `type` per the per-surface variants in `#/$defs`.

id.description: Primary key of the hit. DID for `type = Did`, integer VPR id for `Corporation` / `Ecosystem` / `CredentialSchema`, string id for `ServiceEndpoint`.

score.description: Final ranking score combining the [TG-FCT-4] lexical score with the [TG-FCT-5] trust signals. Absolute scale is implementation-defined.

snippet.description: Per-surface result-card payload; constrained by the discriminated `allOf` branch matching `type`.

highlights.description: Pre-rendered highlight fragments (e.g. with `...` markers around matched terms). Optional and implementation-defined.

DidSnippet.description: Minimum normative shape for a `Did` hit card per [TG-FCT-6a]: identity, trust flags, the result-card fields (service name / type / description / logo plus operator name / logo / country), the owner Corporation's trust signals (deposit and slash history), and the declared service endpoints, so a search response alone can render a service list. Nullable fields MUST be present with value `null` when unavailable, not omitted. Implementations MAY surface additional fields.

pattern.description: Architecture pattern; `null` when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

operatorKind.description: Derived facet per [TG-FCT-3]; `null` when the trust chain is incomplete.

serviceName.description: `ServiceCredential.name`; `null` when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

serviceType.description: `ServiceCredential.type`; `null` when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

serviceDescription.description: `ServiceCredential.description`, optionally truncated for card use (truncation ends at a character boundary and is flagged with a trailing `…`); `null` when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

serviceLogoUri.description: `ServiceCredential.logoUri`; `null` when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

serviceLogoDigestSri.description: `ServiceCredential.logoDigestSri`; `null` when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

operatorName.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.name` or `PersonaCredential.name` (Pattern A: self; Pattern B: issuer); `null` when the trust chain is incomplete.

operatorLogoUri.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.logoUri` or `PersonaCredential.avatarUri`; `null` when the trust chain is incomplete or the Persona has no avatar.

operatorLogoDigestSri.description: Paired `OrganizationCredential.logoDigestSri` or `PersonaCredential.avatarDigestSri`; `null` under the same conditions as `operatorLogoUri`.

operatorCountryCode.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.countryCode` or `PersonaCredential.controllerCountryCode`; `null` when the trust chain is incomplete.

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the DID's owner Corporation per the VPR DID ownership invariant. Never null.

corporationDeposit.description: Owner `Corporation.deposit` (Coin string), via `Did.corporationId`; `null` only while the owner Corporation record is not yet materialised (bootstrap transient).

corporationSlashedEvents.description: Owner `Corporation.slashedEvents` (`0` when never slashed); `null` only while the owner Corporation record is not yet materialised (bootstrap transient).

corporationLastSlashedAtTime.description: Owner `Corporation.lastSlashedAtTime`; `null` when never slashed, or while the owner Corporation record is not yet materialised.

corporationSlashedValue.description: Owner `Corporation.slashedValue` (Coin string); `null` when never slashed, or while the owner Corporation record is not yet materialised.

serviceEndpoints.description: The DID's `ServiceEndpoint` records — the non-`LinkedVerifiablePresentation` `services[]` entries of the DID Document. Always present; empty array when the DID Document declares no such entry.

id.description: DID Document service entry id (DID-relative URL).

serviceEndpoint.description: Endpoint value preserved verbatim per DID-CORE (URI string or object).

isCorporation.description: `true` iff the DID is the current `did` of a `Corporation` entry. Powers the Corporation badge and the `Did.isCorporation` filter.

isEcosystem.description: `true` iff the DID is the current `did` of at least one `Ecosystem` entry (equivalently: `ecosystemIds` is non-empty). Powers the Ecosystem badge and the `Did.isEcosystem` filter.

ecosystemIds.description: Ids of the `Ecosystem` entries whose current `did` is this DID; `[]` when none. Non-empty iff the DID is an ecosystem controller. Powers the Ecosystem badge and the `Did.ecosystemIds` filter.

did.description: The Ecosystem's DID (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.did`; MAY be shared across Ecosystem entries — the key remains `id`).

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the controlling Corporation (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.corporation_id`).

id.description: Stable `uint64` primary key of the Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.id`).

did.description: The Corporation's own declared DID (mirrors VPR `Corporation.did`).

policyAddress.description: On-chain account that signs on behalf of this Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.policy_address`).

didId.description: The owning DID (the `Did` of the `EXPOSES_SERVICE` edge), per [TG-FCT-6a].

FacetAggregation.description: Per-value count for one filter field. Implementations MAY truncate to a top-N for high-cardinality facets.
